name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-3.5
description: 3.5" 320x480 IPS LCD (ST7796, SPI), FT6336 touch, ES8311 audio, TF card, AXP2101, Wi-Fi through its ESP32-C6.
verify: Pins from Waveshare's demo code and schematic (https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-3.5). BSP comment says touch reset is 'Shared with LCD reset' but its own define and the schematic give TP_RST = GPIO29, separate from LCD_RST GPIO27; chose 29. Sound: the ES8311 at 0x18 on I2C 7/8, I2S MCLK 13, BCLK 12, WS 10, data to the codec 9 and the microphone back on 11, speaker amplifier on GPIO 53 (on when high), from Waveshare's lcd35_board.h and the BSP header (pa_reverted false). Compiled; not heard on a board. Wi-Fi is the ESP32-C6 (a bare ESP32-C6FH8) beside the P4, in the kit as the Wi-Fi co-processor on the ESP32 core's own SDIO lines (CLK 18, CMD 19, D0-D3 14-17, reset 54): Waveshare publish no pins for it and their own Arduino Wi-Fi example uses those defaults; the schematic, read for this preset, puts the C6's SDIO among GPIO 14-19 and its CHIP_PU on GPIO 54 through a 0 ohm link, and the order of the six lines is the defaults' by inference. It has to run ESP-Hosted of the core's release, which the board prints at start (see the README). Wi-Fi through it compiles and has not been on a board. Not driven: the C6's Bluetooth; ESP-NOW does not go through the C6. A design on this preset starts on revision 3 of the ESP32-P4, which Waveshare's own Arduino examples for their P4 boards build for; for a chip before revision 3 (the upload says "revision v1.x"), choose that under Hardware > Board > Chip revision.
